cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 4.3.3.0)
set(CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "D:/all_traj_method/gract/CMakeModules")
cmake_policy(SET CMP0126 OLD)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0128 OLD)
project(CMAKE_TRY_COMPILE C)
set(CMAKE_VERBOSE_MAKEFILE 1)
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "")
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS} ${COMPILE_DEFINITIONS}")
set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "")
set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "${CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS} ${EXE_LINKER_FLAGS}")
include_directories(${INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES})
set(CMAKE_SUPPRESS_REGENERATION 1)
link_directories(${LINK_DIRECTORIES})
cmake_policy(SET CMP0083 OLD)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0155 OLD)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0157 OLD)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0181 OLD)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0210 OLD)
include("${CMAKE_ROOT}/Modules/Internal/HeaderpadWorkaround.cmake")
set(CMAKE_ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "D:/all_traj_method/gract/build_mingw_static/CMakeFiles/CMakeScratch/TryCompile-9yh6v8")
add_library(cmTC_a895d STATIC)
target_sources(cmTC_a895d PRIVATE
  "D:/all_traj_method/gract/build_mingw_static/CMakeFiles/CMakeScratch/TryCompile-9yh6v8/testCCompiler.c"
)
file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/cmTC_a895d_loc"
     CONTENT $<TARGET_FILE:cmTC_a895d>)
target_link_libraries(cmTC_a895d ${LINK_LIBRARIES})
